text:
[Council File 26-1609]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
TRADE, TRAVEL, AND TOURISM COMMITTEE REPORT relative to geographic boundaries and potential regional divisions for appointments to the Board of Airport Commissioners pursuant to Charter Amendment PRT.
Recommendations for Council action, pursuant to Motion (McOsker, Padilla, Park – Harris-Dawson):
INSTRUCT the Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA), with the assistance of Los Angeles World Airports (LAWA) and the City Attorney, to report with recommendations on the geographic boundaries and potential regional divisions for appointments to the Board of Airport Commissioners pursuant to Charter Amendment PRT, including options for defining airport-impacted communities surrounding Los Angeles International Airport and Van Nuys Airport, to inform subsequent Council direction and preparation of an implementing ordinance, contingent upon certification of the election results confirming the measure's passage.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council would direct the Chief Legislative Analyst to report on how to divide Board of Airport Commissioners appointments into regions, including how to define airport-impacted communities around LAX and Van Nuys. This work proceeds only after the Charter Amendment PRT election result is certified.

details.action: instruction to report on Board of Airport Commissioners regional divisions
